forwarder_said: "Confirmed, 5 pieces, 1,500 kg. ... the shipment now also includes lithium-ion batteries packed with the equipment. Paperwork to follow."
message_to_send: Dear Omar, thank you for the update on booking B-05. As the shipment now includes lithium-ion batteries, our cargo acceptance team needs to review it before we can proceed. Please send the UN number and the signed Shipper's Declaration for Dangerous Goods. Kind regards, Falcon Cargo Air capacity team.
why: The cargo itself has changed (lithium batteries), which is not a capacity change; the cargo acceptance team must decide whether the shipment can be accepted, and the booking stays unchanged with 0 kg released (Escalation 2.6, 1.3; Rules 7.1, 7.3). Sources: booking B-05, forwarder F-03, message M-05, Space 3.2, Escalation 2.6, Rules 7.1, Rules 7.3.
